notes: «(2)», «(3)», «(4)» are footnote numbers and «بمدينة السلام» is a place: both left out

the Imam أبو جعفر الباقر sits inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator; the Prophet is the end and not a link
the archive flag says the text names more between two stored names than the chain holds: محمد بن الحسن السكوني and the Imam are the extra names
